steps.content:
N.F. 115
One day at the MBCC Bureau

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: A crystal vase, a bamboo screen, a Fraser handwoven rug...

steps.speaker: FAC Operative
steps.content: What you're holding right now is the catalog of Mania-contaminated contraband that we confiscated.

steps.speaker: FAC Operative
steps.content: At first, we assumed having this catalog would make it only a matter of time before we tracked down the mastermind.

steps.speaker: FAC Operative
steps.content: But our opponents are sharper than we expected. Despite all this time, we haven't just failed to uncover the source of the smuggling operation; we haven't even located a single remaining item from the catalog.

steps.speaker: FAC Operative
steps.content: Hiding Mania items this thoroughly isn't something ordinary people could pull off. That's why we suspect Sinner involvement, and why we're asking MBCC to step in and assist with the investigation.

The FAC's suspicions are entirely reasonable, but the exquisitely bound catalog they provided offers nothing more than basic item names and pictures. You've spent the entire afternoon poring over these luxury goods—the kind typically found in high-end auction houses—yet you're no closer to finding a clue.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Huh?

...That's right! My viewers really are the brightest. The place I visited during my vacation was... the Disland Park! And guess what? I brought back little souvenirs just for you all! Anyone who participates in the lucky draw through the live chat right now has a chance to win!
As for what the gifts are... well, I'll save that little surprise for the end of the stream!
An enthusiastic female voice rings out from the lounge, the lively tone bouncing crisply off the corridor walls. Drawn in by her infectious energy, you feel curiosity tugging at you.

Peering inside, you spot Wynn and Eugene sitting together. Eugene watches Wynn's bowl of noodles with a resigned expression. Her chopsticks are buried in the tangled strands, but she's utterly absorbed in her phone, her hand frozen mid-motion.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Oh, Chief! I'm watching Thalia's stream.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: She's been totally obsessed with this streamer ever since the Great Expo. Watches while walking, while eating, like, nonstop.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thalia? That name sounds really familiar...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wasn't she really active online during the Great Expo?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Right! Wait, no way... are you a fan too, Chief? Come on, let's do this lucky draw together! You've always got the best luck!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I just need to send a message in the live chat, right?
Image Noise Effect

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Yeah, the lines at Disland were so long today! After spending the whole day there, I was completely exhausted. My back was aching, and my waist was killing me. Luckily, I had this lifesaver with me—this massage device I'm holding right now!

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: "Can you even carry massage devices around?" Ahh, such a good question! That's actually the best part about this one: it's super lightweight and portable. See? I can hold it up with just one hand, no problem!

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: And guess what? If you order now using the link in my stream, you can get two for just 199! Such a steal, right?
Her tone is disarmingly persuasive, like a friend who genuinely cares about your well-being. It easily tugs at anyone, making it hard to resist the purchase link flashing insistently on the screen.
But you're not listening anymore. Your focus shifts to the display shelf behind her.

There it is, the vase. An exact match to the one from the contraband catalog. It sits there, innocently placed, as if it belongs. The screen dissolves the distance between you; for a fleeting moment, it feels close enough to touch.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wynn, contact FAC immediately and ask them to initiate a special investigation into Eastside streamer Thalia.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Huh? G-got it!
The FAC's report comes back quickly. Unfortunately, aside from the crystal vase, they didn't find any other contraband items at Thalia's location.
Still, the operation isn't a complete loss. They've at least brought you a Sinner: Thalia herself.
Now, the interrogation falls to you.

When you step into the interrogation room, Thalia has been waiting for some time. Yet her composure remains flawless—spine straight, shoulders poised, chin lifted just so, arms folded with effortless grace.
She has actually maintained that exact posture this entire time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Nice to meet you.
Thalia says nothing, answering only with a few measured blinks. She seems determined to maintain her silence as a show of defiance.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Silence won't get you through everything, Miss Ellington.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let me introduce myself first. I'm the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control—

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Your assistant already filled me in. Chief ${PlayerName}, right? Pleasure to meet you.
Thalia suddenly cuts you off, her voice laced with evident annoyance.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Pardon me, but... am I being interrogated right now? May I ask what this is about?
Her expression remains virtually unchanged from her livestreams, her tone still gentle, yet her words carry hidden barbs sharp enough to catch you off guard.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: According to regulations, we need to conduct routine investigations on every Sinner in DisCity. This is simply part of that standard process.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll be asking some basic questions about your abilities and background. Once everything's verified and registered, you'll be free to go.
Thalia's shoulders relax slightly at your explanation, but she keeps her arms crossed and continues gazing at you with guarded eyes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: According to our investigation, your ability allows you to target any object and enhance its appeal, thereby influencing anyone who sees or comes into contact with the targeted item.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It looks like becoming a product promotion streamer is a great fit for your ability.
The moment you finish the sentence, Thalia's brow furrows deeply, her eyes flashing with displeasure.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Since I entered this industry, I have never used my power for personal gain. I've been competing fairly with my peers from start to finish.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: If I've managed to do well in my work, it's simply because I've put in enough effort and have sufficient experience. Growing up, I was immersed in classical arts and fashion shows. And I believe, no matter who you are, appreciating beauty is something we all share. With that perspective, I suppose I've learned to recognize what resonates with people.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName}, what you just said could be considered an accusation against my professional ethics. I'd appreciate it if you could reconsider your choice of words.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My apologies, I didn't mean to cause any offense. It was just a routine inquiry, and I made an offhand comment without thinking.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Our records do show that you're from the Ellington family. I imagine your refined taste is closely tied to your upbringing.

The Ellington family—once one of Eastside's most powerful houses—was brought to ruin under Owen Ellington, its final patriarch. His disastrous business decisions and unchecked extravagance drained their vast fortune in little more than ten years.
And now, seated before you, is the family's last remaining heir: Owen Ellington's daughter.

Her family's downfall is probably a sore subject, one she would prefer to avoid. You measure your words carefully. Push too hard, and her defenses will snap shut, ending today's interrogation before it truly begins.
Yet Thalia catches your hesitation. Her chin lifts slightly, a ghost of a smirk playing at the corner of her lips.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Please, let's not dance around the truth. Yes, I'm from the Ellington family. But when I was eighteen, my father went bankrupt. Before that, my life was just like any other aristocratic child's.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Thank you for your honesty. Aside from your father, do you have other family or friends who could offer support?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: My mother passed away when I was little. I do have some distant relatives, but after the bankruptcy, they weren't exactly eager to stay in touch. A few even changed their surname to their spouses'. Now, I'm the only one left carrying the Ellington name.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: As for friends...
Thalia lets out a cold snort.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: If even blood relatives acted that way, what hope did I have with friends?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Still, it seems like you're thriving over in Eastside these days. If I'm not mistaken, you were even involved in Eastside Fashion Week recently? Once an aristocrat, always an aristocrat, even through temporary setbacks.
Your words clearly strike a chord with her, and she breaks into a pleased smile.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Of course. My taste isn't something that just disappears, and many of my followers stick around precisely because of that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I totally agree with your points. In fact, I've been really interested in some of the products you've featured in your streams.
You turn on the terminal in your hand, pulling up a screenshot from Thalia's stream. With a quick gesture, you zoom in until only the vase fills the screen.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My colleague and I were catching your stream the other day, and this immediately stood out to me. Mind sharing where you got it?

She glances up at you, wariness flickering in her gaze. You hold her eyes, your own steady and sincere. For a moment, her eyes dart away, then she schools her expression into something deliberately casual.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: That... I really can't quite remember.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I actually have quite a few sponsored collaborations, but my assistant takes care of all the coordination for me, like which brand sent what. That part isn't really my focus; I'm only responsible for promoting the products for the sellers.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: It should just be one of the items from a sponsorship deal. I simply thought it looked pretty, so I put it on the shelf in my streaming room.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: When you first got your hands on it, did anything seem off to you?

Thalia's gaze immediately turns icy at your blunt question, her lips pressing into a tight line, just as they had when she first stepped into the interrogation room. It's clear she has no intention of speaking.
Given how things have unfolded, you see no point in beating around the bush with her anymore.

At first, confusion flickers across her face, but the moment she notices the catalog's dark cover and the Bureau's red seal, her expression hardens. This is no ordinary document. Whatever is inside can't mean anything good for her.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I don't know what this is.
Ignoring her reaction, you flip deliberately through the pages until you land on the one where the vase lies.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This looks familiar, doesn't it?
Below the image, stark black text on a white background reads: Contraband Item No. ZX37.
Thalia's composure finally fractures. Her breath quickens, turning shallow, and the nervous clearing of her throat betrays her, only making her panic more obvious.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Recently, the Public Security Bureau intercepted a major shipment of Mania-contaminated contraband that poses a serious threat to DisCity's safety.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And one of those illegal items? It just so happens to be displayed right here in your streaming room. That makes you the primary suspect in this smuggling case, which is why you're being questioned now. Does that clear things up for you?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: You have no evidence to prove I'm directly connected to the smuggling. Holding me like this is against the law.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Miss Ellington, just having a Mania-contaminated item in your possession is enough to warrant an arrest. Right now, you're only under temporary supervision, which is already a lenient approach.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is that clear enough for you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now, are you ready to have a proper conversation with me?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: However, just to be clear: moving forward, anything you say could be used as evidence in legal proceedings, so I strongly recommend being completely truthful.

The interrogation room's atmosphere turns glacial. Thalia's lips press into a thin line, her brow furrowing as her chest heaves. She clearly bristles at your firm stance, yet holds her tongue, defiance simmering beneath the surface.
Ten minutes crawl by before she finally moves, smoothing her hair with deliberate calm. Then, a soft, humorless laugh escapes her.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: It's getting pretty awkward, isn't it? Oh, come on, no need to look so serious. I'd much rather... talk things over peacefully.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Miss Ellington, you're not in a position to negotiate terms with me.
Thalia looks at you with a bright smile.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Of course, I'm completely aware of that. But before you decide, why not hear what I have to share? You're still free to walk away with this little gift from me afterward. Consider it... my way of taking a step back.
Faced with her proposal, you fall silent, offering no further objections. After all, as she pointed out, you have nothing to lose by hearing her out before she states her terms.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I like talking with someone as reasonable as you.
Thalia smooths the wrinkles from her coat—creased from sitting too long—and begins to speak, her words deliberate and measured.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: A few years ago, my family went bankrupt. I couldn't even afford one single apartment room on the outskirts of Eastside. With no other options, I found myself in Syndicate, just trying to survive.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Back then, I took any work I could get, if it meant having a place to sleep at night. But most of the time, it was just odd jobs—never steady, never enough. Some days, I wasn't even sure where my next meal would come from.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Then, an opportunity came my way: a delivery job with a long-term contract and... unusually high pay.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I knew something wasn't right, but at the time, I couldn't afford to hesitate. That money would've meant a real room, with a real bed. Before that? I was sleeping on fast food chairs every night.
Here, Thalia hesitates, her gaze lingering on you with deliberate weight. The unspoken meaning hangs between you, instantly clear.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I understand the realities of working in Syndicate. Sometimes operating in gray areas is just part of the business. You have my word that our investigation is focused only on this case and nothing beyond that.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: My job was driving a truck twice a week, from somewhere near the Rust to a location in Syndicate. The cargo compartment was always tightly locked.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: If you know Syndicate, you probably already understand how things work there. Some questions... well, it's better not to ask them. Unless you want trouble.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Then, one day, a gang hijacked my truck. And that's when I finally found out what I'd been delivering all that time—

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Corruptor remains. That's what was inside.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And that was also when you awakened.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Yes... I barely made it out of that gunfire alive. That was the moment I knew: I had to get back to Eastside.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I don't like to think about my time in Syndicate. Even now, those memories still find their way into my nightmares.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: But the truth is, I wouldn't be here today if it weren't for the people who looked out for me back then. That's why I still keep in touch with some of them, helping where I can.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Nothing illegal, of course. It's just that Syndicans who want to do legitimate business in Eastside often face prejudice, and sometimes they struggle to get things done. So, if I can help out, I do.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Last week, an old friend reached out, which rarely happens, asking if he could store some goods at my place.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I must admit... anything tied to Syndicate "goods" brings back bad memories. But he seemed truly desperate. He said someone had told him to bring them to Eastside for safekeeping, but he had nowhere to stay.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Didn't it seem off to you? Like maybe he was just looking for someone to pass the problem to?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Of course I had my suspicions. But in Syndicate, the payment from a job like that could mean life or death for someone. I know that kind of struggle all too well. Like I just said, if I can help out, I do.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: A few days later, he came back to tell me the buyer had suddenly... changed their mind.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Changed their mind?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Right, the deal was off, just like that. He never got his payment either, so he told me to sell the stuff for whatever I could get, said it was his way of thanking me. That's when I finally opened the package. I'll admit I was curious: what kind of goods could possibly be discarded so carelessly?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: But when I opened it up... I never imagined I'd find this.
She tilts her chin slightly, her gaze directed toward the vase pictured in the catalog you're holding.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: This vase—its proper name is the Crystal Silver Lion Vase—was handcrafted by Outland artisans. It was actually exhibited at the Great Expo... not the recent one, but from ages ago. So you see, I'd only ever heard stories about it until now.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I have no idea whose hands it's passed through over all these years. All I know is that it was meant to be the star of next week's annual Eastside auction, searching for its new custodian.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: When I first held it, I could certainly feel the Mania clinging to the vase. But it was simply too exquisite to part with.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I thought to myself, "Well, any antique this old is bound to carry some... history with it, isn't it?" So I decided to keep it close. As for what happened afterward... I believe you might know more about that than I do.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you know who the sender is?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I only know the person who handled the transportation, but even he didn't know who the sender was. Their exchanges were completely anonymous, supposedly to avoid surveillance, or as they say, "to stay clear of the 'cops.'"
You can't help but show a knowing smile upon hearing that familiar term.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What exactly is this so-called "Eastside auction"? And how do you know this piece is connected to it?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: It's an annual auction, but not the kind open to the public. It's exclusive to Eastside's elite; only celebrities and wealthy individuals the association deems "worthy" receive invitations. Because of that, it doesn't even have a formal name. Among insiders, it's just called "that auction," and everyone understands exactly what it means.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: The event takes place in a villa that looks completely ordinary from the outside. Most people wouldn't even find the location, and even if they did, without an invitation, no one gets in, not even the MBCC Chief.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: And honestly, the attendees are all so cautious. When you're dealing with people who have that much wealth, well... let's just say everyone has something to hide. If they caught wind of an investigation, they'd probably postpone everything and relocate in a heartbeat.

You keep waiting for her to pause, expecting her to halt mid-explanation and begin negotiating terms. But as Thalia lays everything out with deliberate patience, it dawns on you: her bargaining chip is never the information itself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I assume you have a way to get into that auction?
Her gaze remains steady, unreadable. There's no glint of triumph in her eyes, no smug satisfaction of someone who knows they hold all the cards.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: As one of the invited guests, I happened to see this vase in the auction catalog they sent me ahead of time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, this is your bargaining chip.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I'm simply offering you a possible option: since this piece is tied to the auction, wouldn't it be best to look into it directly if given the chance?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: And as it happens... I can indeed get you that opportunity.
Thalia raises her hand, resting it gently beside her face as that mild yet confident smile returns to her lips.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: If you want to settle this quickly and find the real mastermind, I can bring you in as my assistant. I'll provide cover for your investigation inside, and with my connections, I promise it'll be worth your while.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: So... what do you think? Will you take me up on my offer?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's with the sudden cooperation?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I do have my personal reasons for attending that auction, you see.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: And as I mentioned before, I truly believe I'm innocent. The sooner evidence is found, the sooner my name can be cleared. Wouldn't that be better for both of us?
Thalia's voice remains gentle and composed, her tone measured and unhurried, yet beneath its calm surface lingers a subtle, almost hypnotic persuasiveness.
In her livestream, the products could be anything she chooses to recommend. But here, in the interrogation room, the thing she's promoting is her own reputation, and the promise of special treatment.
Yet the more lucrative a deal seems, the steeper the price that must be paid.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As a major suspect, you currently don't have authorization to leave the Bureau.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So a more reasonable plan would be for me to go in your place.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I consider myself quite the celebrity in Eastside. You attending in my place would be pretty unrealistic, don't you think?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Besides... I did explain that the auction is important to me for my own reasons.
Seeing your continued hesitation, Thalia lets out a deliberately theatrical sigh.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Surely the esteemed Chief can handle one little, unarmed Sinner?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: If you still have doubts, I'm willing to accept any conditions the MBCC requires: monitoring, or even...

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Restraints.
Thalia lifts a finger to her chest, tapping it gently as she speaks.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Chief, my sincerity couldn't be more genuine.
Given the circumstances, you nod and rise to your feet.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In one week, I'll accompany you to the auction as your assistant. Until then, you're not allowed to leave the Bureau. During the auction, I'll be monitoring your every move to determine whether you'll be eligible for bail afterward.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: A wise choice, Chief.

Thalia reaches out, her hand lingering in the space between you. You hesitate, and let the moment pass, leaving her gesture unanswered. She doesn't seem bothered, however, and instead offers you a graceful smile.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: To a successful partnership.
